cornerstone.full_quote: RESTRICTIONS ON THE CORNERSTONE INVESTORS Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period of six months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”), dispose of, in any way, any of the Offer Shares or any interest in any company or entity holding such Offer Shares that they have purchased pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreement, save for certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly-owned subsidiaries who will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date (duration wording with inclusive start); frees up on the six-month anniversary of the Listing Date

controller_6m.notes: No Rule 10.07 controlling shareholder undertaking anywhere: zero hits for '10.07' or 'Controlling Shareholder' undertakings in all 603 pages. The underwriting section (p363) goes directly from the Rule 10.08 Company undertaking to the Hong Kong Underwriting Agreement undertakings (p364) with no controlling-shareholder lock-up. The Company is an A+H dual-primary applicant citing new Chapter 19A rules (e.g. Rules 19A.13A, 19A.13C, 19A.15); pre-listing shares are instead restricted by PRC law (p535): 'The shares issued prior to the public issuance of shares by the Company shall not be transferred within one year of the date on which the shares of the Company are listed and traded on a stock exchange.'

controller_12m.notes: No Rule 10.07(1)(b) control-maintenance undertaking. PRC-law substitutes (p535): one-year transfer restriction on pre-listing shares and 'the shares of the Company held by them shall not be transferred within one (1) year from the date on which the shares of the Company are listed and traded' (directors and senior management, max 25% transferable per year during office).
